summary: Frontend testing completed for FarmyGo delivery management app. Tested 5 new features: 1) Scrollable order creation dialog, 2) Courier full name display, 3) SMS status in customer history, 4) Unassigned Orders section with quick-assign, 5) Session lock/PIN verification for couriers. Found and fixed 1 bug in quick-assign functionality (POST vs PATCH method).

minor.issue: Returns 404 Not Found - banner feature may not be implemented

integration_issues.issue: FIXED - Was using POST instead of PATCH for /api/orders/assign endpoint

critical_code_review_comments: Fixed: handleQuickAssign function was using axios.post instead of axios.patch for /api/orders/assign endpoint (line 3761 in App.js)
seed_data_creation: Created test customer 'Test Customer SMS' and order 'SMS Test Order Customer' for testing SMS status feature
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 requested features are working correctly after the quick-assign fix. PIN setup for couriers works, session lock mechanism is implemented (1 hour inactivity timeout). SMS status shows in customer history dialog. Order creation dialog is scrollable. Courier full name is displayed instead of username.

unassigned_orders_section.notes: Section appears when orders without courier exist, shows order details and quick-assign dropdown

quick_assign_dropdown.notes: Fixed POST to PATCH method. Now correctly assigns courier to unassigned orders

order_creation_dialog_scrollable.notes: Dialog has max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto classes, all fields visible and scrollable

courier_full_name_display.notes: Full name displayed in Couriers table (Nome Completo column), courier dashboard header, and getCourierName() function returns full_name || username

sms_status_in_customer_history.notes: SMS status shown as '✓ SMS inviato' (green) or 'SMS non richiesto' in customer history dialog

session_lock_screen.notes: SessionLockScreen component exists (lines 6125-6247), DashboardRouter checks sessionLocked state, PIN verification endpoint /courier/verify-pin exists

pin_verification.notes: PIN setup dialog appears for couriers, PIN can be set (4 digits), stored in localStorage and backend
